data.one_liner: Converts Vietnamese text with signs and accents to unsigned strings.
data.what_it_does: It provides a utility method to strip diacritics and signs from Vietnamese strings, turning them into plain ASCII/unsigned representations. It uses an optimized hashmap engine by default for parsing performance.
use_when: You need to normalize Vietnamese text for search indices or URLs.
You want to remove diacritical marks from Vietnamese strings.
avoid_when: You need a general-purpose localization or multi-language translation engine beyond Vietnamese diacritic removal.
strengths: Very simple and straightforward usage with a single method call.
Engine optimized for performance using hashmaps.
weaknesses: Limited scope, solely focused on converting Vietnamese text to unsigned form.
data.minimal_example:
import 'package:tiengviet/tiengviet.dart';

print(TiengViet.parse('Xin chào việt nam')); // Xin chao viet nam
